name: Laya Decision (System 1)
description: Run a Laya (open-source System 1) typed decision on a self-hosted server. Registers a pre-approved DecisionPack by name; writes the typed answers (choice/score/noul) to the process as 'jev'.

properties.label: Decision pack
properties.description: Name of a DecisionPack registered in the worker (e.g. support/triage). Only pre-approved packs can be selected.

properties.label: State variable
properties.description: Process variable holding the state/context the model decides over.

properties.label: Result variable name
properties.description: Process variable that receives the full decision record (model + typed answers + usage).
